raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 17
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly asserted that the Ensembl November 2020 (release 102) GFF3 was “suitable for our date constraint” of 20/10/2020. This misinterpretation of the temporal requirement led the search down the wrong archive path and ultimately to an incorrect FTP link from release 102, which post-dates the required cutoff (the correct release as of 20/10/2020 would have been 101).
